description.zh:
**如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可。**

链式授权配置，非必填。更多信息，请参见[使用链式授权访问其他实体资源](~~465340~~)。
description.en:
**If you do not have special requirements, leave this parameter empty.**

The authorization chain settings. For more information, see [Use authorization chains to access resources of other entities](~~465340~~).

description.zh: 图片保存时的编码格式。可取值为jpg、png、webp，默认与输入图片编码格式相同。
description.en: The encoding of the output image. By default, the output image uses the same encoding as the input image. Valid values: jpg, png, and webp.

description.zh: 项目名称，获取方式请参见[创建项目](~~478153~~)。
输出图片的压缩质量，仅限jpg和webp图片格式。设置范围为0~100，默认为80。
description.en: The quality of the output image. This parameter applies only to JPG and WebP images. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 80.

description.zh:
源图片的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径。

支持的图片格式：jpg，png，tiff，jp2，bmp。
description.en:
The OSS URI of the input image.

Specify the OSS URI in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format, where `${Bucket}` is the name of the bucket in the same region as the current project and `${Object}` is the path of the object with the extension included.

Supported formats of input images include JPG, PNG, TIFF, JP2, and BMP.

description.zh:
输出图片存储的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径。
description.en:
The OSS URI of the output image.

Specify the OSS URI in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format, where `${Bucket}` is the name of the bucket in the same region as the current project and `${Object}` is the path of the object with the extension included.

description.zh: 处理框及操作类别参数数组。
description.en: The bounding boxes and processing parameters.

description.zh:
高斯模糊的模糊半径，取值范围为1~50，默认值为3，单位为px。
> 该参数仅在添加高斯模糊时生效。
description.en:
The radius of the Gaussian blur. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 3. Unit: pixels.

>  This parameter takes effect only for a Gaussian blur.
The position of the bounding box.

description.zh:
纯色块的颜色，支持`#FFFFFF`形式与预设的`red`、`white`等关键字。默认值为#FFFFFF，即白色。
> 该参数仅在添加纯色块时生效。
description.en:
The color of the color shape. You can specify a color by using a color code such as`#RRGGBB` or preset color names such as `red` and `white`. The default value is #FFFFFF, which is white.

>  This parameter takes effect only for solid color shapes.

description.zh:
马赛克小块的半径大小。默认值为5，单位为px。
> 该参数对于添加高斯模糊与纯色块不生效。
description.en:
The radius of the mosaic. Default value: 5. Unit: pixels.

>  This parameter does not take effect for Gaussian blurs and solid color shapes.

description.zh:
高斯模糊的标准差，取值必须大于0，默认值为5。

> 该参数仅在添加高斯模糊时生效。
description.en:
The standard deviation of the Gaussian blur. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 5.

>  This parameter takes effect only for a Gaussian blur.

description.zh:
添加的马赛克类型。可取值如下：
- square：方形的马赛克
- diamond：菱形的马赛克
- hexagon：正六边形的马赛克
- blur：高斯模糊
- pure：纯色块
description.en:
The type of the mosaic effect. Valid values:

*   square: squares.
*   diamond: diamonds.
*   hexagon: hexagons.
*   blur: Gaussian blurs.
*   pure: solid color shapes.

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解智能媒体管理产品的收费方式和[价格](~~88317~~)。**
- 调用该接口前，请确保当前Region已经存在可用的项目（Project），详见[项目管理](~~478152~~)。
- 该接口支持的输入图片编码格式为jpg与png，单边长不超过30000像素，总像素不超过2.5亿像素。
descriptions.en:
*   Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the [billing](~~88317~~) of Intelligent Media Management (IMM).****
*   Make sure that the specified project exists in the current region. For more information, see [Project management](~~478152~~).
*   The operation accepts JPG and PNG images with a maximum side length of 30,000 pixels and a total of up to 250 million pixels.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm add-image-mosaic --project-name test-project --source-uri oss://examplebucket/sampleobject.jpg --target-uri oss://examplebucket/outputImage.jpg --image-format jpg --quality 80 --targets '[{"Type":"square","MosaicRadius":5,"Sigma":5,"Color":"#FFFFFF","BlurRadius":3,"Boundary":{"X":0.0,"Y":0.0,"Height":200.0,"ReferPos":"topleft","Width":200.0}}]' --credential-config example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
